related_resources.reason: Teopancazco occupation phases, sectors for craft, ritual and food, 116 burials, mobility and diverse links; some social functions are interpretive.
Book description synthesizes excavation of 116 formal burials and ties to coastal raw materials and migrants; the book full chapters not reviewed.
Treats multifamily compounds as a key unit of Teotihuacan urban social organization and considers migrant identities.
Describes Tlailotlacan Zapotec tombs and the merchants’ neighborhood; inferences about diplomatic design are presented as possibilities, not directly demonstrated rules.
Supplementary orientation only, not used to substantiate historical claims.
